description: Implementation of MCP3208 external ADC chip interface, including SPI communication, request handling, and data processing.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the ADC result for a specific channel from the state results array.

methods.name: getMcp3208adc
methods.description: Public function to get ADC value for a specific channel.

methods.name: getNextChannel
methods.description: Determines the next channel to read based on the event counter.

methods.name: spiCallback
methods.description: SPI transfer callback that processes received data and initiates the next ADC request.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Prepares the SPI transmission buffer for a specific ADC channel request.

methods.name: requestAdcValue
methods.description: Starts an SPI exchange to request ADC data for a specified channel.

methods.name: requestAdcValueI
methods.description: Starts an SPI exchange (interrupt mode) to request ADC data for a specified channel.

methods.name: adc_in_out
methods.description: Outputs ADC results and error ratios for debugging or monitoring.

methods.name: init_adc_mcp3208
methods.description: Initializes the MCP3208 ADC interface and SPI communication.
